title: Certify P104 B-linear cube coverage and exclude 612 cube IDs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent checks certify the lex and normalized cube coverage, reconstruct the encoding clauses, and exclude 612 of 1,001 cube IDs by a direct inactive-mask covering contradiction. A fresh f3591 RUP proof supplies an independently checkable refutation for one of those 612. The remaining 389 IDs are listed explicitly.

## Task and overlap

Scoped #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212` on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. #7852 supplies the generator and reports historical verified UNSAT for 1,001 cubes. The original proofs are absent. This archive checks one regenerated proof and the separate coverage and direct contradictions.

## Validation

Ran `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -B verify_all.py` from a clean compact archive copy. The checker binds the regenerated full f3591 CNF hash, 1,680 core clauses and all 235 RUP additions, and rejects three mutations. The finite certificate covers the stated decoder-to-CNF class.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds for the reduction and generator plus the retained PicoSAT and drat-trim authors. Clear1nsight prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

Reduce the 389 residual cubes with explicit proof-producing checks.
